mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = #{lockedStatus}, locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_at = #{now}, lock_until = #{lockUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND ( consume_status IN (#{initStatus}, #{failedStatus}) OR (consume_status = #{lockedStatus} AND lock_until <= #{now}) ) AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until <= #{now})

UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = #{doneStatus}, consumed_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status = #{lockedStatus} AND (#{lockedBy} IS NULL OR locked_by = #{lockedBy})

UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = #{failedStatus}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status = #{lockedStatus} AND (#{lockedBy} IS NULL OR locked_by = #{lockedBy}) AND retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count

UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = #{deadStatus}, dead_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status = #{lockedStatus} AND (#{lockedBy} IS NULL OR locked_by = #{lockedBy})
